messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — noticed p99 jumps on seqlen=512 on a subset of SM95 machines after yesterday's kernel-autotune merge. qps stable but tail latency +18% on small batches. nvprof snapshot attached.
Maria Lopez: ugh, timeline? which merge/PR?
Alex Chen: PR 1234 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1234) — changed kernel selection heuristic to prefer fp8-tc fastpath when SM supports TC+FP8. On some farm nodes, hw handshake reports TC true but BF16 paths still preferred at runtime; leads to mismatched kernel + microkernel calibration. nvprof shows tensor core utilization toggling.
Samir Patel: can you paste the handshake output from device probe? I want to see reported SM and capability flags.
Alex Chen: Sure —
```
probe: sm=95
flags: tensor_cores=1, bf16=0, fp8=1, fp8_format=E4M3, driver=545.23
quirks: slow_fp8_warp_shuffle=1
```
Maria Lopez: looks like BF16 is 0 but our kernel runtime still takes bf16 path for matmul microkernel when sequence<64; mismatch.
Jin Park: hypothesis: driver reports fp8 but our epilogue/cudnn fallback checks bf16 for certain tile sizes; autotuner chose fp8 kernels for seqlen>256 but runtime path for short sequences used legacy bf16 kernels. Race between kernel-selection cache and handshake normalization.
Alex Chen: repro command: `./run_perf --model llama-13b --seqlen 512 --batch 4 --device cuda:0 --kernel-autotune=on` — p99 187ms vs 158ms baseline.
Dana Williams: Ops Bot showed these nodes received a driver update yesterday — 545.23 -> 546.01? @Ops Bot any events?
Ops Bot: node-updates: host=worker-12,driver=546.01,kmod=540. Driver rolled 2026-03-17T03:12Z
Kai Nguyen: If driver changed, hw handshake may report fp8 but actual kernel paths slower due to new driver codegen. Suggest CV: force a quick rollback to previous kernel pick for affected SM/driver combos. Add unit test that simulates handshake flags and validates kernel selection mapping.
Samir Patel: For immediate mitigation: add a capability override env var e.g. `REDWOOD_HW_FORCE_FP8=0` and set on policy for affected pool. Also add metric to Console: per-model kernel_path histogram.
Maria Lopez: I'll open a small PR that reverts heuristic ordering for SM95+ when driver >=546 and sets a canary rollout to 10%.
Alex Chen: Also adding an autotune unit: feed synthetic traces with mixed seqlen distribution and assert no cross-path mismatches. Add nsys flame snippets to the thread.
Jin Park: FYI linking perf log: https://internal.redwood/perf/logs/4620001234/nvprof.txt
Alex Chen: +1. I'll coordinate rollback and a followup autotune patch. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Maria Lopez: tracking issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/789
Ops Bot: deploy: rollback-to=runtime@release-2026-03-16 started by Maria Lopez — ETA 12m
Kai Nguyen: After rollback let's run the smoke matrix across SM93..SM101 to avoid repeated surprise.
Samir Patel: Will add a gating test to CI. If kernel-selection mismatch reproduced, fail PR.
Alex Chen: Great, leave notes in the PR about driver handshake normalization and add test vectors for E4M3 vs E5M2.
Dana Williams: thumbs up. Keep ops posted.
